svg.title: NET-05-S — Pre-winner authoritative score overlay
svg.desc: Existing Tab score overlay on a 1280 by 900 client before a round winner. Retain the existing lower-left score-panel placement, fixed identity labels, bounded result viewport, and scroll controls. No menu canvas, banner, new completed data, or new Close action. Top-left diagram coordinates.

g.text: Only result rows actually available from the current state
No completed-result fixture or invented empty-state message
[Diagram annotation: result body scrolls within these bounds]
Session only scores • Optional scripts disabled
ANNOTATIONS — placeholders describe existing content; they are not new UI copy.
Read identity → section → columns → body → position controls. Keep headings and controls fixed.
Tab retains its existing discrete toggle. Do not add focus targets, dismiss actions, or completed rows.
At smaller supported clients retain current placement and contain the body above network status.
NET-05 / UX-NET-05-006–008. Actual functional state and available values govern capture.
